G1_unambiguity.justification: The elimination process and coupling condition are clear, although the phrase “exactly one sequence of constraints linking any two variables” is slightly awkward and could momentarily be read ambiguously.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement specifies the input bounds and format, valid eliminations, stopping conditions, objective, output, and all relevant edge cases through its definitions and examples.

G3_faithfulness.justification: For a tree, repeatedly eliminating non-target leaves while preserving connectivity leaves exactly the minimum subtree connecting all target variables, so the rewritten task has the same answer for every input.

G4_naturalness.justification: The wording is generally readable but the artificial constraint-system terminology and “evaluation cost” framing make it feel contrived compared with the original cabling problem.
